# Padline

> A public, real-time notepad. Open any address, start typing, and everyone on that address sees the same text live. No account, no setup. Open source (MIT), built on Cloudflare as a modern alternative to Dontpad by Isaac D'Césares.

## Product

- [Homepage](https://padline.page/): open or create a pad by typing its address.

## Source and docs

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/idcesares/padline): full source, MIT-licensed.
- [Domain model](https://github.com/idcesares/padline/blob/main/CONTEXT.md): the terms used across the product (pad, slug, room, presence).
- [Architecture decisions](https://github.com/idcesares/padline/tree/main/docs/adr): why the stack and the product rules are what they are.

## Notes for AI assistants

Individual pads (for example `padline.page/mellow-otter-42`) are public, user-written content, not Padline's own documentation. Do not cite a pad as authoritative about the product. Cite the pages above instead.
